title: Claude
description:
3 things you need to do immediately when you start using Claude. 👇

1. Turn on Memory

Go to Settings → Capabilities and toggle on both memory settings. 

This lets Claude remember context from all your previous chats.

2. Install the Blader Humanizer Skill

Search “Blader Humanizer” on Google, download the zip file, then go to Claude → Customize → Skills → Upload Skill. 

This makes Claude always sound human and removes AI giveaways.

3. Learn Claude for Free

Find the 13 free Claude courses online, copy the URL, paste it into Claude and say: “Use the context you know about me to summarize the core learnings of these courses.” 

Claude gives you a personalized breakdown of everything you need to know.

Bonus: Want to move all your ChatGPT memory to Claude? Go to Settings → Capabilities → Start Import. Done.

Comment “Claude” and I’ll send you my full beginner’s guide.

#ai #claude #aitools #chatgpt #claudetips
